Each package coordinates concise notes, a teaching deck, five student questions, formula and calculator references, and an experiment or explicit no-lab decision. Restricted answer keys are identified without exposing their files. Use the [circuit foundations reference](../circuits/index.qmd) for significant figures, notation, core equations, and the GUESS method.

{{< include ../../includes/generated/tej-circuits-electronics-toc.md >}}

Teachers can use the [electronics lesson-package standard](https://github.com/mrandrewandrade/assets/blob/master/electronics/MODULE-DEVELOPMENT-SOP.md) when building or reviewing a package.
